subject: GreenBridge: subprocessor roster changes after consolidation — evidence & timeline
messages:
From: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@greenbridge.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenbridge.com, security@greenbridge.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor roster — post-consolidation confirmation and evidence request

Hi Ben,

I hope you're well. Following GreenBridge's recent vendor consolidation review, our security team needs an updated subprocessor roster and evidence package covering any partners that now process GreenBridge data as a result of your consolidation earlier this quarter. Specifically we need:

- A current roster (name, country, processing purpose, data types) highlighting any additions or role changes since 2025-05-01.
- Attestations for encryption-in-transit and at-rest where applicable (or documentation of KMS/HSM usage).
- SOC 2 or equivalent audit report summaries for the affected subprocessors, or point us to where we can request them.
- Any planned onshore fallback or residency controls if data is routed through new transit partners.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the roster and a bundled evidence manifest by 2025-07-22? If not, please propose an alternative timeline and let us know any blockers. Procurement will follow up with a formal request once we confirm scope.

Thanks,
Amanda Cole
Head of Vendor Security
GreenBridge Financial

---
Attachment requested: roster + evidence manifest

Amanda, thanks for the clear list — appreciate the heads up.

We can provide the roster and an evidence bundle. Proposing the following plan:

- 2025-07-17: Deliver preliminary roster (spreadsheet) calling out changed entries and the specific consolidation that introduced them.
- 2025-07-20: Deliver evidence manifest with links to SOC 2 summaries, KMS attestation notes, and encryption statements.
- 2025-07-22: Finalized deliverable and Q&A session (30 min) if you want a short walkthrough.

Kimberly / Marissa — looping you in to pull the roster and assemble the manifest. Marissa, can legal confirm whether a DPA addendum or a short attestation letter is required from our side for the new transit partner?

Amanda — quick clarifying question: do you need full SOC 2 reports or redacted summaries will suffice for now? Also, are there any specific data classes (PII/financial identifiers) you want us to flag at the top of the spreadsheet?

Ben Carter

Marissa / Jordan — forwarding GreenBridge's request. Ben proposed target dates above. I started a quick inventory pull and attached two artifacts for internal review: subprocessor_roster_20250715.xlsx (workbook with tabs: current, changes, flags) and evidence_manifest_20250715.zip (placeholders with links and notes). Highlights so far:

- Two transit/observability partners were consolidated into a single vendor (EdgeSync) in June; their processing footprint now includes telemetry aggregation (device/user agents) and transient logs. Flag: need to confirm whether GreenBridge considers telemetry within "sensitive financial data" for their DPA scope.
- KMS: EdgeSync uses our central KMS provider (onshore key management), we have attestation but final exportability matrix is outstanding.
- SOC 2: one new subprocessor (CacheWave) is SOC2 Type II; second (MetricPulse) has a SOC2 in progress — we have interim control summaries.

Action items I propose:
1) Jordan: prepare a short attestation letter template (DPA addendum lite) that we can sign for the affected partners; include KMS/cipher details at a high level.
2) Marissa: confirm whether redacted SOC 2 summaries + control mapping are sufficient or if GreenBridge will require full reports.
3) Kimberly: finish the roster CSV and mark any entries requiring onshore fallback.

I'll attach the working files to Ben's outbound to Amanda once we have Marissa/Jordan confirmations.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Ben / Kimberly / Marissa / Jordan — thank you for the fast response and the proposed plan. 2025-07-17 for the preliminary roster and 2025-07-20 for the evidence manifest works for our timeline.

A few quick clarifications:
- Redacted SOC 2 summaries with a control mapping are acceptable for initial review. If any of the new subprocessors are in an "onshore only" requirement list, our procurement team will flag that and request an escalation.
- For telemetry, please flag any flows containing financial identifiers (account numbers, transaction IDs) explicitly.

Procurement will send a formal RFP/manifest request today (procurement@greenbridge.com). We'd like to schedule the 30-minute walkthrough on 2025-07-22; I'll propose a time via calendar invite.

Appreciate the collaboration — looking forward to the deliverables.

Best,
